assumptions: Nonnegative saved PL proper electron densities; theorem assumption unless a specific observed prior positivity receipt is cited
Shared positive H on identical stored ln(a) overlap
Thomson limit hbar*omega << m_e*c^2 and k_B*T_e << m_e*c^2

algorithm.quadrature: uniform left and right Riemann sums of w and w^2; nondecreasing w proves left <= integral <= right
extra_checks: matter-only analytic upper moments dominate numerical full-background upper moments up to quadrature slack; do not assert this for a finite upper sum without allowing its known width
algorithm.rounding_policy: Use math.fsum; calculate a separate 50-digit decimal reference for scalar formulae and background endpoint values. Float formulae evaluated, not interval-certified. Do not introduce an arbitrary physical-error inflation factor.

acceptance.metadata: Exact equality of named coordinate, pair names, observable, units and union-knot count; frozen parsed scalar values must match source intake
acceptance.riemann_moment_relative_bracket_definiti: For each raw moment p=1 and p=2, (U_p-L_p)/U_p; the p=2 check precedes taking a square root
acceptance.source005_background_checks: Endpoint H finite/positive; all density parameters nonnegative; q_ref=0 and shared scenario recorded
acceptance.interpretation: Acceptance verifies equations and bounded compact evaluation; it is not a threshold admitting solver convergence or physical observational accuracy
